description: **Links between a project's docs and its posts resolve on the unified site.** A project served under a shared site's mount is served two roots at once -- its documentation under its slug, its posts at the site root -- and a reference crossing between them is now written against the root that serves the target. Cross-page term links, the auto-glossary's Source links, and every reference a post writes back into its own project used to name addresses the site does not serve.
